description: WorkOS handles all authentication for the Nyuchi ecosystem. SSO, SCIM provisioning, multi-tenancy, and JWT issuance. All Cloudflare Workers validate WorkOS JWTs independently — no central auth server in the request path. The design portal (mzizi.dev) uses WorkOS AuthKit for the sign-in UI. API write operations require a valid WorkOS JWT in the Authorization header. MCP authenticated tool calls require a WorkOS JWT. Read-only API endpoints and public MCP tools are unauthenticated.
